brief.description: Draft a task brief for the org
brief.template: Create a Brief artifact for a task in .agents/project/org/decisions/_drafts/ using the Brief template in .agents/general/org/contracts.md (max 400 tokens). Ask me the task, tier (1/2/3/discovery), stake, and success criteria if not provided, then write the file and report the BRIEF-ID.

debate.description: Run a Tier-3 debate: two positions, disagreement map, synthesis
debate.template: Run the Tier-3 debate protocol for the given brief (or ask me which brief): (1) invoke big-pickle subagent for Position A, (2) invoke gemini-planner subagent for Position B (independent, neither sees the other), (3) invoke big-pickle to write the disagreement map, (4) invoke hermes-bridge to write the synthesis. File all artifacts in .agents/project/org/decisions/_drafts/ per the contracts in .agents/general/org/contracts.md. Then present the synthesis to me with the DECISION-REQUESTED question.

rule.description: Record a CEO ruling and update the ledger/blueprint
rule.template: Record the CEO ruling: capture my APPROVE/REJECT/MODIFY decision on the synthesis, invoke the logger subagent to write the decision file (decisions/D-YYYYMMDD-NNN.md), update decisions/index.md and cost-ledger.md, archive _drafts artifacts, then invoke big-pickle to update the blueprint if the ruling changes structure, and invoke conductor for the quality gate before anything is marked done.

conduct.template: Invoke the conductor subagent. It will run the project quality gate per .agents/project/org/quality-gate.md (pytest tests/, pass rate >= 90%, no new failures vs baseline) and emit a CONDUCTOR report. Report the result to me and state whether anything may be marked done.

tendencies.template: Invoke the data-scientist subagent to update .agents/project/org/tendencies.md from the decision ledger and cost ledger, and to surface alternative-data discovery signals. Summarize the top insights for me.

fallback.description: Switch the org to opencode-only mode (no paid tokens)
fallback.template: Apply the opencode-only fallback: read .agents/general/org/fallback.md, verify the model swap map, and check .opencode/agent/ for any agent currently pinned to a paid (google/* or anthropic/*) model. Revert those model lines to the free fallback IDs, note the degradation ladder step (default Step 1), and confirm the org runs free. Restart opencode after changes.
